notes.subject: tok bilong David
notes.rationale: Hebrew has first-person עשיתי (mi mekim) with no speaker named; the attribution to David is inferred from context.

notes.subject: foa tausen
notes.rationale: Verse counts the Levite divisions: 4,000 gatekeepers and 4,000 praisers.

notes.subject: עשיתי
notes.rationale: 'Which I made' vs 'which David made' — first person implies direct speech of David embedded without introduction.

translation: Na foa tausen ol man bilong lukautim dua bilong banis, na foa tausen ol man bilong singautim nem bilong Yahwe, wantaim ol kain kain samting we mi mekim bilong singautim nem — tok bilong David.

tokens.gloss: ol man bilong lukautim dua bilong banis
